$description: Iconography. Lucide (ISC), 24x24 grid, stroke-based. Stroke-width is a function of size so the rendered line stays in a 1.17-1.50px band at every size.

d3.why: The package name. Not a style value.

14.$description: inline with 11-12px metadata; the smallest icon the system allows

16.$description: the default - inline with 14px body, buttons, table cells

24.$description: section headers, empty states, standing alone

$extensions.d3.pairing: The icon box is one step larger than the text size: 12px text takes a 14px icon, 14px text takes 16px. A stroke glyph reads lighter than a letterform of the same height, so matching the em box makes the icon look shrunken.
$extensions.d3.alignment: display:inline-flex; align-items:center. Never vertical-align, never a margin-top.
d3.icon-only-allowed: has a tooltip on hover and on keyboard focus
is one of a small learnable set: close, search, expand, more, edit
d3.icon-only-forbidden: anything that spends money or messages a person
anything appearing only a handful of times
the primary action of a page or dialog
anywhere the icon is the only signal of a state
d3.animated: confirmation check drawing once - never looping in production
$extensions.d3.custom: Only when Lucide has no equivalent. Same constraints: 24x24 viewBox, stroke-based, round caps and joins, 2-unit nominal stroke, no fills except where the shape is the meaning.
